import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int P;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= P;
            if (v < 0) v += P;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v % P;
            if (val < 0) val += P;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            val = (val + o.val);
            if (val >= P) val -= P;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt o) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * o.val % P);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt addEq(ModInt o) {
            val = (val + o.val);
            if (val >= P) val -= P;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mulEq(ModInt o) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * o.val % P);
            return this;
        }

        static ModInt add(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val + b.val);
        }

        static ModInt mul(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt((long) a.val * b.val % P);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        ModInt[][] binom = new ModInt[n + 2][n + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = new ModInt(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = new ModInt(binom[i - 1][j - 1].val + binom[i - 1][j].val);
                if (binom[i][j].val >= P) binom[i][j].val -= P;
            }
        }

        ModInt[] cnt = new ModInt[m + 1];
        ModInt[] dp1 = new ModInt[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            cnt[i] = new ModInt(0);
            dp1[i] = new ModInt(0);
        }
        cnt[0] = new ModInt(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModInt term = new ModInt(0);
                term.val = (int) ((long) dp1[j].val * cnt[i - j - 1].val % P);
                ModInt term2 = new ModInt((long) dp1[i - j - 1].val * cnt[j].val % P);
                term.val = (term.val + term2.val);
                if (term.val >= P) term.val -= P;
                term.val = (int) ((long) term.val * (j + 1) % P);

                ModInt term3 = new ModInt((long) cnt[i - j - 1].val * cnt[j].val % P);
                term3.val = (int) ((long) term3.val * (j * (j + 1) / 2) % P);
                term.val = (term.val + term3.val);
                if (term.val >= P) term.val -= P;

                term.val = (int) ((long) term.val * binom[i - 1][j].val % P);
                dp1[i].val = (dp1[i].val + term.val);
                if (dp1[i].val >= P) dp1[i].val -= P;

                ModInt cnt_term = new ModInt((long) binom[i - 1][j].val * cnt[j].val % P);
                cnt_term.val = (int) ((long) cnt_term.val * cnt[i - j - 1].val % P);
                cnt_term.val = (int) ((long) cnt_term.val * (j + 1) % P);
                cnt[i].val = (cnt[i].val + cnt_term.val);
                if (cnt[i].val >= P) cnt[i].val -= P;
            }
            cnt[i].val = (cnt[i].val * 2) % P;
            dp1[i].val = (dp1[i].val * 2) % P;
        }

        ModInt[][] dp2 = new ModInt[n + 2][m + 1];
        ModInt[][] dp3 = new ModInt[n + 2][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp2[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                dp3[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        dp2[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        dp3[0][0] = new ModInt(0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                    if (j + k > m || i + k + 1 > n + 1) continue;

                    ModInt val2 = new ModInt((long) dp2[i][j].val * binom[m - j][k].val % P);
                    val2.val = (int) ((long) val2.val * cnt[k].val % P);

                    ModInt val3 = new ModInt((long) dp3[i][j].val * cnt[k].val % P);
                    ModInt val3_part2 = new ModInt((long) dp1[k].val * dp2[i][j].val % P);
                    val3.val = (val3.val + val3_part2.val);
                    if (val3.val >= P) val3.val -= P;
                    val3.val = (int) ((long) val3.val * binom[m - j][k].val % P);

                    dp2[i + k + 1][j + k].val = (dp2[i + k + 1][j + k].val + val2.val);
                    if (dp2[i + k + 1][j + k].val >= P) dp2[i + k + 1][j + k].val -= P;

                    dp3[i + k + 1][j + k].val = (dp3[i + k + 1][j + k].val + val3.val);
                    if (dp3[i + k + 1][j + k].val >= P) dp3[i + k + 1][j + k].val -= P;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp3[n + 1][m].val);
    }
}
